text: Privacy Policy for Infinity.CLO
Effective Date: 04-07-2025

At Infnity.clo, your privacy is our priority. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect your personal information when you interact with us—whether you're browsing our website, making a purchase, or subscribing to updates. Your trust means everything to us, and we are committed to keeping your data safe and secure.
1. What Information We Collect
We collect both personal and non-personal information to provide you with the best possible shopping experience.
A. Personal Information
When you place an order or reach out to us, we may collect:
Full Name
Email Address
Shipping & Billing Address
Phone Number
Payment Details (processed securely by third-party providers)
B. Non-Personal Information
This includes information collected automatically when you use our site, such as:
Browser and device type
IP address
Pages visited and time spent on site
Referring website or link
2. How We Use Your Information
We use your information for the following purposes:
To process and ship your orders
To provide customer support and order confirmations
To personalize your shopping experience
To send promotional offers and updates (only if you opt in)
To analyze trends and improve our website’s functionality
We never sell or rent your personal data to third parties.
3. How Your Information Is Protected
We implement the highest standards of security to protect your data, including:
SSL encryption for secure browsing and transactions
Secure payment gateways (like Stripe or PayPal)
Restricted access to customer data within our team
Routine monitoring of our systems for threats or breaches
4. When and Why We Share Information
We only share your information with trusted service providers that help us operate our business, including:
Shipping companies (to deliver your orders)
Payment processors (to complete secure transactions)
Email platforms (for sending opt-in promotions or updates)
These providers are required to protect your information and use it only for the services they provide us.
5. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
Our website uses cookies to improve your shopping experience. Cookies help us:
Keep track of your shopping cart
Save your preferences
Analyze site traffic and usage
You can manage or disable cookies in your browser settings at any time.
6. Your Rights & Choices
You have full control over your personal information. At any time, you can:
Request access to your data
Update or correct your information
Ask us to delete your data
Unsubscribe from marketing emails (link is provided in every email)
To make a request, contact us directly at ApparelInfinity85@gmail.com
7. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically to reflect changes in our practices or services. When we do, we’ll revise the “Effective Date” at the top of this page. Please check back regularly for updates.
8. Contact Us
If you have any questions or concerns about how your information is handled, we’re here to help:

📧 Email: AppareIinfinity85@gmail.com
📱 Instagram: @Infnity.clo
At Infnity.clo, your privacy and trust mean everything to us. Thank you for being part of the journey.
